title: ClaimScope: Reproducible Repository-Level Reanalysis of Artifact-Size Reporting in Agentic Pull Requests
description: Research software and reproducibility artifact for repository-level D6 metric analysis of 1,699 published performance pull requests. Includes hash-pinned source labels, source-linked Rspack audits, a 97-PR automated size-report census, a frozen 476-comment temporal metadata ledger, public-source match traces, deterministic replay scripts, and integrity tests. The original August 2026 private evidence snapshot is not included; historical inputs and contemporarily retrievable public GitHub records are distinguished. Third-party source labels, bot reports and original extractor code remain attributed to their sources and are governed by their original terms.
